newsitem.title: USA: Option Care gets $30 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Option Care gets $30 mln credit facility.

text.p: Option Care Inc said Thursday it received a $30 million senior secured, revolving line of credit facility, which will allow it to continue acquiring home healthcare-related businesses.
The credit facility also will be used for general corporate purposes.
PNC Bank acted as agent for a bank group that includes Harris Bank, Northern Trust Co and First National Bank of Chicago.
The company said interest rate options available to it are expected to result in reduced borrowing costs.
The new facility replaces Option Care's previous $15 million revolving line of credit.

"I am enthusiastic that Option Care, through the efforts of PNC Bank N.A., has expanded its financial resources to continue our acquisition program in 1997," Erick Hanson, president, said in a statement.
Option Care said its strategy is to provide one-stop home healthcare services, including infusion therapy, durable medical equipment, nursing and respiratory therapy in clustered geographic areas.

Option Care made 12 acquisitions, including five franchises and seven non-franchise businesses, in 1996. It has a national network of 184 franchised and company-owned locations, representing $250 million in annual billings.
